description.value: Natural Bridge is a striking geological formation in Yoho National Park where the emerald-green Kicking Horse River has eroded through solid limestone to create a natural stone arch. Located just off the Yoho Valley Road, it is a well-known and easily accessible roadside stop within one of Canada's most scenic mountain national parks. Touring cyclists riding through the Canadian Rockies often include it as a short detour from the Trans-Canada corridor.
